newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan newspaper office bombed, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan newspaper office bombed, no casualties.

text.p: A bomb ripped through a newspaper office in the southern port city of Karachi on Monday, but caused no casualties, police said.

An official of the bomb disposal squad said the 400-gram (14-ounce) device exploded at about 6.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) outside the reception area of the independent Urdu-language evening newspaper Qaumi Akbar.
The bomb damaged the paper's administration and advertising departments and left a small crater, witnesses said.
No one immediately claimed responsibility and there was no word on a possible motive for the attack.
